projects.name: ProjectWolf
projects.description: Multi-chain cryptocurrency presale platform allowing users to swap ETH, SOL, and BNB for WOLF tokens across scheduled time-based rounds with dynamic pricing algorithms.
features: Multi-chain token presale supporting cross-currency swaps (ETH, SOL, BNB) for WOLF
Automated time-based tiered round pricing progression
15-second TTL in-memory rate caching from Binance API to prevent rate limits
Webhook-driven on-chain payment verification via Alchemy and QuickNode
Atomic database state management using Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL

projects.name: ShareThere
projects.description: Location-aware community social media network that discovers and organizes content within local geographic groups using MongoDB geospatial queries and real-time payment webhooks.
features: Hyper-local post discovery utilizing MongoDB $geoNear aggregation and 2dsphere indexing
3-tier radial proximity metrics (near, medium, far) with cursor-based pagination
Stripe Webhooks integration for recurring community subscriptions
PayPal Webhooks integration for real-time user donation confirmations
Role-based moderation, user following activity feeds, and rich post authoring

projects.name: FaceWish
projects.description: Automated greeting and event card generation platform that isolates user facial features from uploaded photos and blends them into customizable character templates with instant rendering.
features: Server-side composite image rendering pipeline using Sharp and Canvas
Face cutout handling and seamless blending into professional character templates
Multi-character template filtering and interactive customization layers
Dynamic sticker resizing, layering, and background swapping endpoints
Instant high-resolution digital card generation and delivery

projects.name: CICS Trading Web Panels
projects.description: Commodity trading and financial dashboard application providing real-time gold and silver spot price feeds, automated order bookings, and inventory tracking.
features: Real-time spot rate calculation and live dashboard broadcast
Order booking and customer position management panel
Automated trade validation and transaction ledger generation

projects.name: OWR - SaaS E-commerce Platform
projects.description: Enterprise multi-vendor e-commerce platform allowing sellers to build independent digital storefronts, manage product catalogs, and handle automated logistics and fulfillment.
features: Multi-tenant relational database schema using PostgreSQL and Sequelize
Redis caching layer reducing database read load by over 40%
Integrated courier logistics APIs (Shiprocket, Delhivery) for automated dispatch and tracking
SMS and transactional OTP alert pipelines via MSG91
Automated integration test suites with Mocha and Chai, validated via Zod

projects.name: Lavado Car Wash Platform
projects.description: On-demand car wash booking and fleet management ecosystem connecting customers, mobile service washers, and administrative supervisors across three dedicated portals.
features: 3-tier application architecture: Customer booking, Washer service app, and Admin panel
Automated first-available washer dispatch algorithm with administrative override capabilities
Recurring subscription packages and one-time service appointment scheduling
Push notification delivery pipeline for real-time service status transitions

projects.name: Xira Real-Time Chat Platform
projects.description: High-concurrency real-time team collaboration and messaging application featuring channel management, direct messaging, read receipts, and file sharing.
features: Low-latency duplex communication powered by Socket.io and Redis Pub/Sub
One-on-one direct messages and multi-user group channels
Typing indicators, online presence tracking, and message delivery receipts
Media and document attachment processing with Cloudinary storage

projects.name: Automated WhatsApp Trading Bot
projects.description: Automated messaging and trading assistant utilizing whatsapp-web.js to synchronize market orders and broadcast transactions across high-volume trader groups.
features: Automated WhatsApp message parsing for structured buy/sell trade instructions
Simultaneous broadcast of market rates and trade confirmations across multiple groups
Session persistence and automated reconnection handlers
